info.name: Import & Recovery
info.description:
CredVault › Import & Recovery: the sample file (25 tabs, Excel and CSV), import by category with the form's validation and the failed list, Imported Credentials History, Download backup (Excel / CSV, My / Team Vault, passwords, password lock) and Downloaded Backup History.

BEFORE YOU START
Fill baseUrl, email/password and adminEmail/adminPassword. The upload requests pick their files from docs/postman-samples (credvault-import-sample.xlsx, credvault-import-login.csv, credvault-import-card-with-errors.csv) — if your project is elsewhere, re-select them in Body → form-data. Run the folders in order.

Full details: docs/CREDVAULT_VAULTS_API_SHEET.md → Import & Recovery.

adminEmail / adminPassword — a client admin (sees everyone's history, backs up the Team Vault).

item.name: 01 · Download sample file — 25 tabs, Excel and CSV
item.description:
GET /imports/types — the 25 categories of the import screen: each with its sheet (tab) name, its columns (required, hint, the allowed values) and the files attached after the import.
GET /imports/sample?format=xlsx|csv&type= — the sample: one sheet per category, laid out as that category's form, with two example rows that pass every check.
• xlsx → one workbook, 25 tabs (Login … Outdoor License) + How to fill
• xlsx&type=login → that tab + How to fill
• csv&type=login → that sheet as a CSV
• csv → a .zip with the 25 CSVs (a CSV has no tabs) + how-to-fill.csv
• layout=simple → the older any-type sample (name, url, username, password, category, notes).
Postman: Send and Download to save the file.

item.name: 02 · Import by category — preview, failed list, import
item.description:
POST /imports/preview (form-data: type, file) — choose the category, upload its sheet. Every row is checked as that category's Add form checks it (required fields, web address, email, phone, dates, the select lists, card number + expiry, IFSC, CVV / PIN, seed phrase, setup key, lengths, name, risk, rotation). Nothing is saved yet.
Response: token · stats {rows, valid, failed, duplicates, weak, selected} · rows[] (row = the sheet row, status valid | failed, errors [{field, label, message}], flags dup | dupfile | weak, notes, selected) · failed[] — the failed list.
An .xlsx is read at the tab named for the category — so the 25-tab sample (or an Excel backup) can be uploaded as it is.

POST /imports { token, rows: [index…], duplicates: skip | copy, scope?: personal | team, department_id? } — imports the picked valid rows through the Add form. Response: the history row + failed_rows + imported_codes. The token works once.

item.name: 03 · Imported Credentials History
item.description:
GET /imports — Sr. No · Import ID (IM-…) · Imported On · Imported By (name, initials, role; "You") · File (+ "<source> · into My Vault") · Format (Excel / CSV) · Imported · Skipped · Weak · Duplicates · Failed · Category. `records` = the badge. A Vault Admin sees everyone's; others their own (mine=1 for only yours).
GET /imports/{id} — one import with its failed list.

exec: pm.test('rows and the records badge', () => { pm.expect(b.data.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(b.records).to.be.above(0); });

04 · Download backup — Excel / CSV, My / Team Vault, passwords, lock
item.description:
GET /backups — the Backup settings and the Downloaded Backup History: scopes [{scope: mine | team | all, label, count}] (My Vault · 29 credentials), the columns, and the history rows.
POST /backups { format: xlsx | csv | json, scope: mine | team | all, include_passwords, lock, password, password_confirmation, account_password? } — the file.
• Choose a format — Excel (.xlsx) or CSV.
• Choose what to include — My Vault or Team Vault; Include passwords on/off.
• Lock the file with a password — on: the file is put in an AES-256 .zip that only the backup password opens (7-Zip, WinRAR). The password needs 8+ characters with letters, numbers & symbols, typed twice. CredVault does not store it.
• Passwords included and the lock off — the file is readable, so your account password is asked again.
An Excel backup has the summary sheet, one tab per type in the import layout (so a tab can be imported back to restore it) and About. A protected (locked critical) credential's secrets are never written. Response headers: X-CredVault-Code (BK-…), X-CredVault-Items, X-CredVault-Withheld.

exec: pm.test('My Vault and Team Vault counts', () => pm.expect(b.scopes.map(s => s.scope)).to.include.members(['mine', 'team']));

05 · Downloaded Backup History
item.description: GET /backups (history part) — Sr. No · Backup ID (BK-…) · Downloaded On · Downloaded By (name, initials, role) · Format · Scope (My Vault / Team Vault / All vaults) · Items · Size (KB) · Protection (Password locked / Not locked) · Status (Downloaded / Failed, with the reason). `records` = the badge.

exec: pm.test('a Failed attempt is listed', () => pm.expect(b.data.some(r => r.status_label === 'Failed')).to.eql(true));
pm.test('a password-locked one is listed', () => pm.expect(b.data.some(r => r.protection === 'Password locked')).to.eql(true));
